children: In his new role, Yadava will oversee Front Office operations, manage VIP and MICE movements, enhance guest experience and support operational and service excellence

Jaipur Exhibition and Convention Centre (JECC) and Novotel Jaipur Convention Centre – Managed by Accor have appointed Anand Yadava as Front Office Manager, bringing over 15 years of hospitality experience across Front Office and Rooms Operations, guest experience, MICE operations, VIP handling, revenue optimisation and team leadership.

Yadava joins from The Leela Ambience Convention Hotel, New Delhi, where he served as Deputy Front Office Manager and managed Front Office operations for the 480-key luxury convention hotel. His responsibilities included high-volume arrivals, MICE groups, VIP movements, guest journeys, inventory management, forecasting and upselling strategies.

Over the course of his career, Yadava has worked with hospitality brands including The Leela, Radisson and Lemon Tree Hotels, gaining experience in guest handling, VIP protocols, revenue control, service recovery, group movements and team development.
In his new role, Yadava will oversee Front Office operations, manage VIP and MICE movements, enhance guest experience and support operational and service excellence.

“We are pleased to welcome Anand to the team. His extensive experience, strong operational expertise, and focus on guest experience will play a valuable role in further strengthening our Front Office operations and service excellence.”

Manik Vishnoi, Director of Operations, Novotel Jaipur Convention Centre & JECC – Managed by Accor, said the appointment is expected to support the property’s focus on guest experience and operational excellence.
